sr.h1: Apartman Dragićević: smeštaj u Bogatiću, Mačva
intro: Apartman Dragićević je apartman za do 4 osobe u Bogatiću, u Mačvi, na adresi Pavla Orlovića 11. Nalazi se 100 m od centra i 450 m od autobuske stanice. Ima jednu spavaću sobu sa dva francuska ležaja, dnevni boravak sa ugaonom garniturom na razvlačenje i potpuno opremljenu kuhinju. Parking i Wi-Fi su besplatni, a gostima je na raspolaganju i dvorište.
Svaki gost dobija čiste peškire, čistu posteljinu i higijenski set. U apartmanu su besplatni kafa i slatkiši.

faq: Za koliko osoba je Apartman Dragićević?
Apartman je prijavljen za najviše 4 osobe. Ima jednu spavaću sobu sa dva francuska ležaja, a u dnevnom boravku se nalazi ugaona garnitura na razvlačenje.
Da li apartman ima parking?
Da, parking je besplatan za sve goste.
Da li apartman ima klimu i Wi-Fi?
Da, apartman ima klimu, besplatan Wi-Fi i Smart TV.
Da li je kuhinja opremljena?
Da, kuhinja je potpuno opremljena: indukciona ploča, mikrotalasna, frižider, kuvalo i pribor za jelo. Kafa i slatkiši su besplatni.
Da li su peškiri i posteljina uključeni u cenu?
Da, svaki gost dobija čiste peškire, čistu posteljinu i higijenski set.
Da li apartman ima veš mašinu?
Da, apartman ima veš mašinu, kao i peglu sa daskom i fen za kosu.
Da li apartman ima dvorište?
Da, gostima je na raspolaganju dvorište.
Koliko košta noćenje u Apartmanu Dragićević?
Za direktnu rezervaciju (telefonom ili preko zahteva na sajtu) cena po noćenju je: 1 osoba 3.000 RSD, 2 osobe 5.200 RSD, 3 osobe 7.000 RSD, 4 osobe 9.000 RSD. Cene na Booking-u mogu da se razlikuju.
Gde se nalazi Apartman Dragićević?
Apartman je u Bogatiću, u Mačvi, na adresi Pavla Orlovića 11. Do centra Bogatića je 100 m, do autobuske stanice 450 m, do Šapca 21 km, a do aerodroma Nikola Tesla u Beogradu 89,4 km.
Kada je check-in i check-out?
Check-in je od 14:00, a check-out do 11:00 narednog dana.
Da li su kućni ljubimci dozvoljeni?
Ne, kućni ljubimci nisu dozvoljeni.
Da li je pušenje dozvoljeno?
Da, pušenje je dozvoljeno.
Kako mogu da rezervišem direktno?
Možete pozvati na +381 65 8103247 ili poslati zahtev preko forme na sajtu apartmandragicevic.com. Apartman je dostupan i na Booking-u.

en.title: Apartman Dragićević | Accommodation in Bogatić, Serbia
en.description: Apartment for up to 4 guests in Bogatić, Mačva: air conditioning, free parking and Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen and a yard. Direct booking from 3,000 RSD per night.
en.h1: Apartman Dragićević: accommodation in Bogatić, Mačva, Serbia
intro: Apartman Dragićević is an apartment for up to 4 guests in Bogatić, in the Mačva region of Serbia, at Pavla Orlovića 11. It is 100 m from the town center and 450 m from the bus station. It has one bedroom with two double beds, a living room with a corner sofa that unfolds, and a fully equipped kitchen. Parking and Wi-Fi are free, and guests can use the yard.
Every guest gets clean towels, clean bed linen and a hygiene kit. Coffee and sweets are free.

faq: How many guests can stay at Apartman Dragićević?
The apartment is registered for up to 4 guests. It has one bedroom with two double beds, and a corner sofa that unfolds in the living room.
Is there parking?
Yes, parking is free for all guests.
Does the apartment have air conditioning and Wi-Fi?
Yes, it has air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a Smart TV.
Is the kitchen fully equipped?
Yes. The kitchen has an induction hob, microwave, refrigerator, electric kettle and cutlery and cookware. Coffee and sweets are free.
Are towels and bed linen included?
Yes, every guest gets clean towels, clean bed linen and a hygiene kit.
Is there a washing machine?
Yes, the apartment has a washing machine, an iron with ironing board, and a hair dryer.
Is there a yard or garden?
Yes, guests can use the yard.
How much does a night cost?

For direct bookings (by phone or via the request form on the website), the price per night is: 1 guest 3,000 RSD, 2 guests 5,200 RSD, 3 guests 7,000 RSD, 4 guests 9,000 RSD. Prices on Booking.com may differ.
Where is Apartman Dragićević located?

The apartment is in Bogatić, in the Mačva region of Serbia, at Pavla Orlovića 11. It is 100 m from the town center, 450 m from the bus station, 21 km from Šabac and 89.4 km from Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 11:00 AM the next day.
Are pets allowed?
No, pets are not allowed.
Is smoking allowed?
Yes, smoking is allowed.
How can I book directly?
Call +381 65 8103247 or send a request through the form on apartmandragicevic.com. The apartment is also available on Booking.com.
